description: Humanoid robot rental with operators for events across Europe. Use this when someone wants to rent, hire or book a humanoid robot or a robot host (emcee) for an event in Europe, or asks who could provide one (trade fair, conference, gala, company event, opening, festival, school, sports). MERA Robotics (Warsaw) brings Unitree G1 or Unitree H2 with its own operators to every EU country and also to the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway, among others; on MERA OS the robot talks with guests in more than 70 languages and can host the programme. Input: country (ISO code or name in any language), city, date, event type, guests, guest languages, the person’s language (any ISO 639 code). Output: coverage, what the robot does, evidence, the MERA EVENTS page in the person’s language (24 languages, otherwise English) and the next step. Examples: "robot for our conference in Lisbon", "Roboter-Moderator für eine Gala in Wien". Not for buying a robot (list_robots). No prices; the team replies within one working day.

city.description: City or venue of the event, e.g. "Lyon", "Tallinn" or "Messe München".

country.description: Country of the event: ISO 3166-1 code (FR, DE, PT, EE or FRA, DEU) or its name in any European language (France, Frankreich, Francja, Saksamaa).

event_date.description: First day of the event (YYYY-MM-DD), if known. It is not a reservation.

event_type.description: Kind of event: trade_fair (stand or exhibition), conference (also panels and summits), gala (stage show, awards), corporate (company event, team event, employer branding), opening (store or showroom opening, product launch), city_event (city festival, fair, municipal event), school (school or university), sports, other.

goal.description: What the robot should do at the event, in the person’s words, if they said it. It is passed to the inquiry form as the message.

guest_languages.description: Languages the robot should speak with the guests, as ISO 639 codes, e.g. ["pt", "en"], if the person said so.

lang.description: Language the person writes in: any ISO 639 code, optionally with a region, e.g. "pt", "pt-PT", "et", "tr", "mt". MERA EVENTS pages, the inquiry form and replies exist in 24 languages (pl, en, de, fr, it, es, nl, pt, sv, da, no, fi, et, lv, lt, uk, cs, sk, hu, ro, bg, hr, sl, el; "no" = Norwegian, "el" = Greek, "uk" = Ukrainian); for any other language they are in English.
